idea-plugin.name: STM32 Wave Scope
idea-plugin.description: Plot STM32 global variables while the CPU runs, using read-only OpenOCD Tcl memory reads. No firmware instrumentation or extra GDB target connection. Offline ELF resolution uses arm-none-eabi-gdb. Includes struct/array expansion, dual-cursor measurements, explicit scalar RAM editing, per-channel plots, CSV export and a hardware-free demo.
